description: The bar chart compares the execution accuracy of two systems, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across four categories: Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The vertical axis represents execution accuracy, ranging from 20 to 60, with a scale increment of 10. The horizontal axis lists the four categories. For each category, two bars are displayed side-by-side: a light blue bar for NatSQL and a darker blue bar for TA-SQL. In the Simple category, NatSQL has an accuracy of 60.21, while TA-SQL has a higher accuracy of 63.14. In the Moderate category, NatSQL achieves 39.64, and TA-SQL achieves 48.60. In the Challenging category, NatSQL has an accuracy of 32.32, and TA-SQL has 36.11. For the Total category, NatSQL's accuracy is 51.35, and TA-SQL's is 56.19. In all four categories, TA-SQL demonstrates a higher execution accuracy than NatSQL.
